lines.speaker: narrator
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Raat ke do baje... hospital ki corridor sunsaan thi.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Papa admit hue. Counter ne bola — ek lakh assi hazaar advance.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Ek lakh assi hazaar... insurance ne sirf partial cover kiya.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Nahi... abhi tak koi solution nahi mila.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: ATM limit khatam ho chuki thi.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Is waqt kise phone karun? Sab so rahe the.

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.name: Receptionist
lines.text: Ek minute... aap NeerCred try kijiye.

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.name: Receptionist
lines.text: Phone se eligible offers mil jaate hain. Branch jaane ki zaroorat nahi.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Sach mein? Itni raat ko bhi?

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.name: Receptionist
lines.text: Haan. Compare karke apply kar sakte hain.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Maine NeerCred khola... partner lenders ke offers ek screen pe.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Compare karke best option choose kiya. Fully digital.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Jab clarity mili... ek pal ke liye saans aayi.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.name: Meera
lines.text: Tension kam hui. Ab decision clear tha.
